source_review: The primary source explicitly equips the relative sheaf of differentials with its universal S-derivation and states that postcomposition gives a bijection Hom(Omega,F)→Der_S(O_X,F) for every module sheaf F. This is the actual CotangentPresentation structure in Base04. No smoothness, finite-type, or separation premise is used.
effect_on_audit: canonicalMap_differential has no new direct admission, but its chosen cotangent object inherits this generic universal-presentation leaf. The cotangent base-change wrapper has this inherited leaf and the exact canonical base-change leaf. This inventory makes that existing dependency explicit; no proof source or admission boundary was changed.
